1.1 Central idea

Use the supplied parent only as a valid fallback and a reservoir seed. The primary optimization mechanism is a feasible-population, global-stochastic reservoir search. At every candidate generation step we produce one or more proposed coefficient vectors, enforce the two original constraints immediately by an exact projected waterfilling routine, and judge the candidate by the task evaluator itself:
\[

The search explores the feasible simplex using exact evaluations of many constructed step-functions: recombination of existing feasible vectors, weighted convex mixing, block mass transfers, sparse pairwise mass pumping, block interval smoothing, and covariance-scaled stochastic diffusion. 1.2 Why this addresses the previous bottleneck

The parent has likely reached a strong local optimum of the deterministic pipeline. Linearmized edge moves and smooth surrogate rules can follow one active-set topology and become cyclic.
